title: pm-dispatch: register objectstack-ai/mobile as an on-demand repo lane
body:
No issue: this registers a sibling repository for the PM loop, at the maintainer's direction (quoted below).

## What changes

- `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`:
  - `GOVERNED_REPOS` gains `{ id: 'mobile', slug: 'objectstack-ai/mobile' }`;
  - the docblock records why;
  - the two self-test pins that spell the roster move five → six.
  - The scoped `workflows` row is unchanged, so mobile's EAS workflows are not a governed surface (same as hotcrm). The default-scoped rows (ADRs, `.claude/**`, skills, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, North Star) now govern mobile too.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/mobile.md` (new): the `repo:mobile` seat charter.
  - The seat is summoned on demand and creates no patrol routine.
  - Business UI stays in the Console; the shell takes native capability only.
  - Console defects found on mobile are filed at objectstack, never worked around in the shell.
  - While a push to `main` runs `eas-build` / `eas-update`, merges in that repo are the maintainer's (AGENTS.md release directive).
  - Device-only acceptance goes to the maintainer and is never reported as verified.
- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`: the pm vocabulary loop includes `objectstack-ai/mobile`. No `repo:mobile` seam row is added, because no reader exists yet.
- `references/project-forms.md`: the seat words include `mobile`.
- `references/cross-repo-coordination.md`: the single-lane repo list includes `mobile`.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: rows for the new charter (49 lines, 0 table-row bytes), at the landed count.

## Why

`objectstack-ai/mobile` 2.0 is a native shell around the Console (objectstack-ai/mobile#144). Its follow-up cards (objectstack-ai/mobile#145–#148) need a seat to be dispatched. Admission was put to the maintainer as three options; the answer was:

> Register, seat on demand (Recommended)

The rationale presented with that recommendation: most follow-up work lands in this repository's existing `ui` / `server` lanes (#29039–#29042), so the mobile lane's volume is low and a standing routine would spend budget on an empty queue.

## Verification

Run in this branch's worktree, each with its exit code captured before any pipe:

- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: 164 cases pass. The gate itself exits 0; it first flagged 7 charter lines over the 120-byte budget, which were wrapped before the pin was set.
- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs` (and `--self-test`): clean.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test`: 537 assertions, exit 0. It needs `pnpm install` first.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-prose.mjs`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --self-test`: 753 cases. `OWN_REFERENCE_PREFIXES` derives from the roster.
- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`: 5185 cases.
- `node scripts/pm/check-label-desc-cap.mjs`: exit 0.
- `npx eslint` on the two changed `.mjs` files: clean. `bash -n scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`: ok.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test`: still running when this PR was opened; CI carries it.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Nothing here publishes: `scripts/pm` and `.claude/**` are repo tooling, so there is no changeset.

## Landing

Governed surface: `.claude/**` is Tier S and no Tier H path is touched. This PR is left in draft for its contract-tier review of record. The steps after merge belong to the maintainer:

- install the fleet App on `objectstack-ai/mobile`;
- run `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` against it;
- the seat's first summons writes its seat post.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 mobile 仓登记进 PM 循环:受管仓名册加一行，新增 `repo:mobile` 席位宪章（按需召唤、不建巡查 routine），标签词表与席位词同步。
- 为什么改:mobile 已改为宿主 Console 的原生壳，后续卡要靠 pm-dispatch 派发；你选了「登记、按需召唤」。
- 风险与回滚:只动 PM 工具与 `.claude/**`，不碰产品包；回滚即还原本 PR。mobile 的 EAS workflow 不纳入受管面。
- 先看:`references/lanes/mobile.md` 的「常设承诺」，尤其是「main 上 push 触发 EAS 期间合并归你」这一条。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test` 与 `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`，两者都应退出 0。
- 需要你做的:按 Tier S 走达档复核后落地；合并后在 mobile 仓安装车队 App，再对它跑一次 `ensure-pm-labels.sh`。
